title: Pin & Fallback onboarding storyboard and export-ready artboards
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, illustrated storyboard and export-ready artboards for the Rollouts & Version Pinning onboarding flow. Focus on the lightweight guided wizard (first-time run), the version pin composer, canary/A-B split visualizations, and the fallback policy editor. Deliver high-fidelity artboards, annotated specs for engineering, microcopy variations for UX writing, and an export pack (SVG/PNG/JSON) for docs and console screenshots.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file with named artboards for each onboarding step exported and linked
Static PNG and SVG exports for release notes and docs (2x and 3x resolutions)
Annotated specs covering spacing, colors, token estimates, and motion hints
UX copy vetted with PM and included as separate text layer in Figma
Design review approval recorded and no outstanding blocker items for eng handoff
screens: FTU: Welcome card with 3-step progress and 'Pin model' CTA
Pin wizard step 1: choose model version (dropdown + metadata preview)
Pin wizard step 2: traffic routing defaults (canary + A/B presets)
Canary composer: slider, preview traffic split, latency/cost estimate badges
A/B scenario: row comparison with sample outputs panel
Fallback chain editor: drag-to-reorder, conditional selectors, manual fallback preview
Policy preview modal: visual summary, rollback button, estimated RPS impact
Success toast: 'Pin applied' with next steps link
annotations: Primary CTA copy: 'Pin and deploy' (emphasize safety with tooltip)
Help text under traffic slider: 'Start with 5% canary for safety; increase after 24h'
Token estimate badge unit: 'tokens/1k inputs' displayed in gray 12px label
Accessibility: ensure slider keyboard controls and 4.5:1 contrast for badges
Motion: use 160ms ease-out on slider handle, Lottie asset for canary wave intro
Color usage: use brand-500 for primary, caution-400 for canary region, neutral-300 for disabled
notes: PM requested an additional microcopy variant addressing regulated customers (on-prem/private).
Engineering flagged that fallback chain requires server-side validation for circular deps; added as dependency.
Decided to use Lottie for docs animated preview instead of GIF for better fidelity and smaller size.
Keep sample outputs anonymized and limited to 2 examples per scenario to reduce cognitive load.
tasks: Create primary artboards in Figma and establish naming conventions
Produce 2x and 3x PNG exports for docs and release notes
Export Lottie for canary slider intro and attach to docs page
Write microcopy variants and align with legal for regulated language
Prepare annotated export (SVG + markdown) for frontend handoff
Schedule design review with PM and eng and capture signoff
